```{r, message = FALSE}
library("lmtest")
library("prais")
library("sandwich")
library("tseries")
library("wooldridge")
```

### Example 12.1
```{r}
data("phillips")
```

Static Phillips curve
```{r}
model_12_1_1 <- lm(inf ~ unem, data = phillips)

res_static <- model_12_1_1[["residuals"]]
res_static_1 <- c(NA, model_12_1_1[["residuals"]][-(length(res_static))])

model_12_1_1_test <- lm(res_static ~ res_static_1)
summary(model_12_1_1_test)
```

Augmented Phillips curve
```{r}
model_12_1_2 <- lm(I(inf - inf_1) ~ unem, data = phillips)

res_aug <- model_12_1_2[["residuals"]]
res_aug_1 <- c(NA, model_12_1_2[["residuals"]][-length(res_aug)])

model_12_1_2_test <- lm(res_aug ~ res_aug_1)
summary(model_12_1_2_test)
```

Heteroskedasticity robust t statistic
```{r}
coeftest(model_12_1_1_test,
         vcov = vcovHC(model_12_1_1_test, type = "HC0"))
```

```{r}
coeftest(model_12_1_2_test,
         vcov = vcovHC(model_12_1_2_test, type = "HC0"))
```

### Durbin-Watson Test
```{r}
# from package lmtest
dwtest(inf ~ unem, data = phillips)
dwtest(I(inf - inf_1) ~ unem, data = phillips)
```

### Example 12.2
```{r}
data("prminwge")

model_12_2 <- lm(lprepop ~ lmincov + lusgnp + lprgnp + t, data = prminwge)

res_12_2 <- model_12_2[["residuals"]]
res_12_2_1 <- c(NA, model_12_2[["residuals"]][-length(res_12_2)])

model_12_2_test <- lm(res_12_2 ~ lmincov + lusgnp + lprgnp + t + res_12_2_1,
                      data = prminwge)
summary(model_12_2_test)
```

For comparison the test with strict exogenous regressors
```{r}
summary(lm(res_12_2 ~ res_12_2_1))
```

### Example 12.3

```{r}
data("barium")

model_12_3 <- lm(lchnimp ~ lchempi + lgas + lrtwex + befile6 + affile6 +
                   afdec6,
                 data = barium)

res_12_3 <- model_12_3[["residuals"]]
n_res <- length(res_12_3)
res_12_3_1 <- c(NA, model_12_3[["residuals"]][1:(n_res - 1)])
res_12_3_2 <- c(NA, NA, model_12_3[["residuals"]][1:(n_res - 2)])
res_12_3_3 <- c(NA, NA, NA, model_12_3[["residuals"]][1:(n_res - 3)])

barium_res <- cbind(barium, res_12_3)
barium_res <- cbind(barium_res, res_12_3_1)
barium_res <- cbind(barium_res, res_12_3_2)
barium_res <- cbind(barium_res, res_12_3_3)

model_12_3_test <- lm(res_12_3 ~ lchempi + lgas + lrtwex + befile6 + affile6 +
                        afdec6 + res_12_3_1 + res_12_3_2 + res_12_3_3,
                      data = barium_res)

# Drop the first 3 observations to make the test statistics comparable
model_12_3_test_res <- lm(res_12_3 ~ lchempi + lgas + lrtwex + befile6 +
                            affile6 + afdec6,
                          data = barium_res[-(1:3), ])

anova(model_12_3_test, model_12_3_test_res)
```

Seasonal autocorrelation
```{r}
res_12_3_12 <- c(rep(NA, 12), model_12_3[["residuals"]][1:(n_res - 12)])
barium_res <- cbind(barium_res, res_12_3_12)

summary(lm(res_12_3 ~ res_12_3_12, data = barium_res))
```

Include regressors
```{r}
summary(lm(res_12_3 ~ lchempi + lgas + lrtwex + befile6 + affile6 + afdec6 +
             res_12_3_12,
           data = barium_res))
```

### Example 12.6
```{r}
data("intdef")

model_12_6_1 <- lm(i3 ~ inf + def, data = intdef)
summary(model_12_6_1)
```

```{r}
res <- model_12_6_1[["residuals"]]
res_1 <- c(NA, res[-length(res)])
summary(lm(res ~ -1 + res_1))
```

```{r}
model_12_6_2 <- lm(I(diff(i3)) ~ I(diff(inf)) + I(diff(def)), data = intdef)
summary(model_12_6_2)
```

Correlation between $i3_t$ and $i3_{t-1}$
```{r}
i3 <- intdef[["i3"]]
cor(i3, c(NA, i3[-length(i3)]), use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
```

Regression of $e_t$ on $e_{t-1}$
```{r}
res <- model_12_6_2[["residuals"]]
res_1 <- c(NA, res[-length(res)])
summary(lm(res ~ -1 + res_1))
```

### Example 12.7
```{r}
data("prminwge")

model_12_7_1 <- lm(lprepop ~ lmincov + lusgnp + lprgnp + t, data = prminwge)
summary(model_12_7_1)
```

### Still looking for the SC/heteroskedasticity robust se.
```{r}
pw_12_7_1 <- prais_winsten(lprepop ~ lmincov + lusgnp + lprgnp + t,
                           data = prminwge,
                           index = "t")
summary(pw_12_7_1)
```

### Example 12.8
```{r}
data("nyse")

model_12_8 <- lm(return ~ return_1, data = nyse)
summary(model_12_8)
```

```{r}
res <- model_12_8[["residuals"]]^2

model_12_8_bp <- lm(res ~ return_1, data = na.omit(nyse))
summary(model_12_8_bp)
```

### Example 12.9
```{r}
data("nyse")

model_12_9 <- lm(return ~ return_1, data = nyse)

```

```{r}
u <- model_12_8[["residuals"]]
u_1 <- c(NA, u[-length(u)])
usq <- model_12_8[["residuals"]]^2
usq_1 <- c(NA, usq[-length(usq)])

model_12_9_arch <- lm(usq ~ usq_1)
summary(model_12_9_arch)
```

```{r}
model_12_9_3 <- lm(u ~ u_1)
summary(model_12_9_3)
```
